second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (79 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints label (27) twice (q027, q027b); match q26 rows numbered 1)-10) are part of q26, not questions; 81 questions. Answer side: 1-25, [match block], 27-45 continuous (+1 ahead of the questions from q027b), then '45.' again at the two-mark heading, 46-79; q80 (colour) has no key. Offset band q027b-q044 -> keys 28-45 left EMPTY with 'shifted numbering — see key N' (18 questions) for the coordinator's content verification. Difficulty per question: easy 58, average 11, difficult 12, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 11 (heading) 12 (LO, q1-9) 13-16; A pdf 115 (heading, keys 1-6) 116-121.

Question labels printed in parentheses '(1)'. Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5 (heading '...write them down(Easy)' wrapped); s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '(26) Match and write (easy)' q26 (own numbered line; rows 1)-10) / 1.-10.); s5 one mark q27-44 vsa (incl. q027b); s6 two marks q45-59 sa; s7 three marks q60-69 sa; s8 four marks q70-80 la.

NUMBERING: label (27) printed twice -> q027 and q027b (v1.4 §14.1). The answer side numbers continuously: '27. Sita' answers q027 by printed number; keys 28..45(first) run +1 ahead (key 28 'On the edge of the forest' answers q027b 'Where does Sita live?' … key 45 'Neem, Amla' answers q044). Default lane (v2 §4.2): q027b-q044 EMPTY + 'shifted numbering — see key N' (N = label+1; q027b -> 28). q045 takes the second printed '45.' (two-mark run) with 'displacement boundary'. Analysis: reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-03_numbering_analysis.md.
Answer-side section headings print '(Easy – 1 mark each)' on s1-s5 — answer-side headings never set marks (v2 §2); question-side marks headings rule (R-E5).
T/F stems print a trailing dash answer space ' –' / '—' / '.-': removed from text, kept in text_as_printed. q7 stem keeps the printed stray 'g' ('forest.g').
q79 key ends with an empty bullet '●' directly before the Lesson 4 heading (pdf 121) — residue, not stored (3 steps).
q80 figure -> stimulus st-evs-4-03-q80 (crop in images/evs-4-03/stimuli/, ruling D4); no key printed -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_03.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
